english.title: Provide facilities for gambling other than under an exception
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) provided facilities for gambling, namely **(..SPECIFY THE FACILITIES PROVIDED..), which were not excepted by provisions contained in the Gambling Act 2005
english.legislation: Contrary to section 33(1) and (4) of the Gambling Act 2005.

english.notes:
(i) Section 250 of the Gambling Act 2005 also exempts persons acting in accordance with a permit to maintain and supply single machines.
(ii) Unauthorised gambling in a street or public place would be covered by this offence.

other.penalty:
Fifty one weeks imprisonment and/or a fine not exceeding level five on the standard scale.

Time limit for prosecutions:
12 months

On the 12th March 2015 the limit on fines imposed by a Magistrates’ court was removed – as such, the potential fine on summary conviction in relation to an offence committed after this date is unlimited.
